messages:
maria_support: heads up — incoming ticket from an EU customer, their token-cost dashboard shows $0 and some NaNs since ~02:30UTC. billing ledger shows normal charges. they attached a screenshot. :eyes:

nora_billing: thanks, forwarding their org id. did they upgrade or change plan?

maria_support: no plan change. org_id: org_eu_42. customer says monthly bill still accurate, it's only the dashboard widget.

sam_engineer: can you paste the screenshot link and any repro steps? i'll check joins between usage and pricing tables.

maria_support: screenshot: https://files.redwood.example/s/abc123/screenshot.png. they say they saw the zeros after a small UI reload. repro steps from customer: 1) open token-costs UI 2) select EU region + last 30d 3) notice zeros/NaN on some org rows.

jordan_data: running quick query on prod mirror for org_eu_42 — usage rows exist for date range. preliminary eyeball: pricing join returns NULL for some rows when region = 'eu-west-1' and pricing_snapshot < '2026-03-01'.

sam_engineer: that smells like a migration/price snapshot TTL. can you paste the query you ran?

jordan_data: ```sql
SELECT u.day, u.tokens, p.unit_price
FROM usage_hourly u
LEFT JOIN pricing_snapshots p ON u.product = p.product AND u.snapshot_id = p.id
WHERE u.org_id = 'org_eu_42'
AND u.day BETWEEN '2026-02-25' AND '2026-03-17'
ORDER BY u.day DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

nora_billing: if unit_price is null, dashboard calc = tokens * unit_price -> null or 0 depending on reducer, which matches NaN/0. our downstream aggregation sometimes coerces null to 0 for cost totals. need to be careful.

sam_engineer: i can put a quick guard in widget to show "est. cost unavailable" but we need root fix. Jordan, can you check when pricing_snapshot for eu-west-1 last refreshed?

jordan_data: checking... looks like the price refresh job failed on 2026-03-02 01:12UTC for eu region (timeout to pricing API). there was a retry but snapshot_id stayed null for some product SKUs.

maria_support: customer is asking for ETA on fix + whether their billing is affected (they're anxious).

nora_billing: billing unaffected, ledger uses committed price table which was backfilled from billing ingest. this is strictly a UI/analytics problem. reassure customer but say we're investigating and will follow up. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-789 — pricing-snapshot-refresh-failure-eu (severity: low->medium). assigned: sam_engineer, jordan_data.

sam_engineer: plan: 1) re-run price refresh for eu products with forced snapshot (low risk) 2) run a backfill to recompute dashboard aggregates for 2026-02-28..2026-03-17 3) push temporary UI guard to avoid showing $0/NaN. will target first two steps within 2h.

jordan_data: kicking off forced refresh now. i'll run a dry-run first. i'll paste results when done.

maria_support: copied. i'll message the customer with a short note: "We see a pricing refresh issue causing display zeros in the dashboard for EU orgs. Your actual billing is unaffected. We're rerunning the refresh and backfilling dashboard aggregates; expect an update within ~2h." ok?

nora_billing: good. add that it's an analytics display issue, not billing.

sam_engineer: update — dry-run shows missing SKUs for two EU-only SKUs due to unexpected SKU mapping change. fixing mapping and re-running.

jordan_data: re-run finished, snapshot ids created. now starting aggregate backfill job: `jobs/recompute_costs --org org_eu_42 --start 2026-02-28 --end 2026-03-17`

ops-bot: Job started: recompute_costs-5532 (queued).

maria_support: i'll ping customer with progress and link to support case. thanks all.

sam_engineer: once backfill completes i'll verify dashboard values and mark incident resolved. if anyone sees other EU orgs with same issue please tag here.

jordan_data: backfill completed successfully in ~14m. verified cost rows now populated, NaNs gone for sample orgs.

sam_engineer: deploying UI guard rollback and smoke testing dashboard.

maria_support: customer confirmed dashboard now shows expected numbers. closing loop. :tada:
